title: Crisp Peach Cobbler
description: Chef John's version is a lot crispier than a regular cobbler, and you can use this technique for other fruit cobblers. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
ingredients: 6 large fresh peaches, pitted and cut into eighths
0.5 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
2 tablespoons cold water, or as needed to wet topping sugar

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Place a baking sheet on the rack under the middle rack to catch drips. Generously butter a 2-inch deep (2-quart) baking dish.
Place peach sections into prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and zest.

Stir butter and sugar together in a mixing bowl. Mix until creamed and resembles a sugary, buttery paste, 4 to 5 minutes. Add oats and flour; stir until flour and oats are incorporated into the butter-sugar mixture and mixture resembles coarse crumbs, 4 to 5 minutes. Pour in milk; stir until mixture is wet and creamy, like a thick spreadable batter, 3 to 4 minutes.
Drop batter by spoonful on top of the peaches. Spread batter evenly over the surface of the peaches. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar on the batter. Spritz with water until sugar is wet and surface glistens.
Bake in preheated oven on middle rack until browned and crispy, about 45 minutes. Let cool at least 30 minutes before serving.

video.description: Begin a delicious journey into peaches covered in crisp topping by mixing butter with sugar, then work in self-rising flower and rolled oats to create a mixture that resembles bread crumbs. Pour in some milk to soften into a spreadable batter. Slice 6 peaches and cut each half of peaches into 4 slices and load into a buttered dish, then stir with lemon juice and zest. Transfer the batter topping and spread over. Sprinkle the top with sugar and moisten with fresh cold water. Bake inside a hot oven until golden. Cover with vanilla ice cream and ride out the summer in pure crisp peachy bliss.
